{
  "dataset_name": "spambase",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-opus-4.7",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "log_capital_total",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed total capital run length to compress the extremely heavy tail for linear margins.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "capital_usage",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smoothed monotonic signal of shouting/promotional tone, well-scaled for linear SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(capital_run_length_total)"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_capital_longest",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed longest capital run length to reduce skew.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "capital_usage",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Continuous severity measure of sustained capitalization bursts.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(capital_run_length_longest)"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_capital_average",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed average capital run length.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 8.0],
      "feature_family": "capital_usage",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth normalized capitalization intensity for linear projection.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(capital_run_length_average)"
    },
    {
      "name": "capital_intensity_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of longest capital run to total capital run, capturing burstiness vs spread.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "capital_usage",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Bounded ratio that differentiates a single big shout from many small ones.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(capital_run_length_longest / (capital_run_length_total + 1.0), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "total_word_freq_sum",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of all word_freq_* features representing total tracked vocabulary density.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 200.0],
      "feature_family": "aggregate_density",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Composite magnitude useful as a normalization baseline and linear contributor.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "word_freq_0+word_freq_1+word_freq_2+word_freq_3+word_freq_4+word_freq_5+word_freq_6+word_freq_7+word_freq_8+word_freq_9+word_freq_10+word_freq_11+word_freq_12+word_freq_13+word_freq_14+word_freq_15+word_freq_16+word_freq_17+word_freq_18+word_freq_19+word_freq_20+word_freq_21+word_freq_22+word_freq_23+word_freq_24+word_freq_25+word_freq_26+word_freq_27+word_freq_28+word_freq_29+word_freq_30+word_freq_31+word_freq_32+word_freq_33+word_freq_34+word_freq_35+word_freq_36+word_freq_37+word_freq_38+word_freq_39+word_freq_40+word_freq_41+word_freq_42+word_freq_43+word_freq_44+word_freq_45+word_freq_46+word_freq_47"
    },
    {
      "name": "char_freq_special_sum",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of all char_freq_* features representing density of special characters.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 50.0],
      "feature_family": "aggregate_density",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures overall punctuation/symbol density which often correlates with promotional content.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "char_freq_0+char_freq_1+char_freq_2+char_freq_3+char_freq_4+char_freq_5"
    },
    {
      "name": "high_volume_word_share",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Share of frequency contributed by the top-mean word tokens (18, 20, 24, 26, 11) relative to total.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "aggregate_density",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalized composite of high-base-rate tokens, providing a bounded smooth signal.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(word_freq_18+word_freq_20+word_freq_24+word_freq_26+word_freq_11) / (word_freq_0+word_freq_1+word_freq_2+word_freq_3+word_freq_4+word_freq_5+word_freq_6+word_freq_7+word_freq_8+word_freq_9+word_freq_10+word_freq_11+word_freq_12+word_freq_13+word_freq_14+word_freq_15+word_freq_16+word_freq_17+word_freq_18+word_freq_19+word_freq_20+word_freq_21+word_freq_22+word_freq_23+word_freq_24+word_freq_25+word_freq_26+word_freq_27+word_freq_28+word_freq_29+word_freq_30+word_freq_31+word_freq_32+word_freq_33+word_freq_34+word_freq_35+word_freq_36+word_freq_37+word_freq_38+word_freq_39+word_freq_40+word_freq_41+word_freq_42+word_freq_43+word_freq_44+word_freq_45+word_freq_46+word_freq_47+1e-6)"
    },
    {
      "name": "dollar_exclaim_intensity",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-scaled combination of special character frequencies often associated with promotional content (char_freq_4 = '$', char_freq_5 = '!').",
      "value_range": [0.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "special_character",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth log-transformed signal of attention-seeking punctuation for linear margin.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(char_freq_4 + char_freq_5)"
    },
    {
      "name": "nonzero_word_diversity",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Count of word_freq_* features that are non-zero, normalized by 48.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "diversity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Bounded diversity score; spammy messages often concentrate on fewer tokens.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.where(word_freq_0>0,1,0)+np.where(word_freq_1>0,1,0)+np.where(word_freq_2>0,1,0)+np.where(word_freq_3>0,1,0)+np.where(word_freq_4>0,1,0)+np.where(word_freq_5>0,1,0)+np.where(word_freq_6>0,1,0)+np.where(word_freq_7>0,1,0)+np.where(word_freq_8>0,1,0)+np.where(word_freq_9>0,1,0)+np.where(word_freq_10>0,1,0)+np.where(word_freq_11>0,1,0)+np.where(word_freq_12>0,1,0)+np.where(word_freq_13>0,1,0)+np.where(word_freq_14>0,1,0)+np.where(word_freq_15>0,1,0)+np.where(word_freq_16>0,1,0)+np.where(word_freq_17>0,1,0)+np.where(word_freq_18>0,1,0)+np.where(word_freq_19>0,1,0)+np.where(word_freq_20>0,1,0)+np.where(word_freq_21>0,1,0)+np.where(word_freq_22>0,1,0)+np.where(word_freq_23>0,1,0)+np.where(word_freq_24>0,1,0)+np.where(word_freq_25>0,1,0)+np.where(word_freq_26>0,1,0)+np.where(word_freq_27>0,1,0)+np.where(word_freq_28>0,1,0)+np.where(word_freq_29>0,1,0)+np.where(word_freq_30>0,1,0)+np.where(word_freq_31>0,1,0)+np.where(word_freq_32>0,1,0)+np.where(word_freq_33>0,1,0)+np.where(word_freq_34>0,1,0)+np.where(word_freq_35>0,1,0)+np.where(word_freq_36>0,1,0)+np.where(word_freq_37>0,1,0)+np.where(word_freq_38>0,1,0)+np.where(word_freq_39>0,1,0)+np.where(word_freq_40+word_freq_41+word_freq_42+word_freq_43+word_freq_44+word_freq_45+word_freq_46+word_freq_47>0,1,0)) / 41.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "char_to_word_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of special character density to total word frequency density.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures stylistic skew toward symbols vs words, useful as a discriminative ratio.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((char_freq_0+char_freq_1+char_freq_2+char_freq_3+char_freq_4+char_freq_5) / (word_freq_0+word_freq_1+word_freq_2+word_freq_3+word_freq_4+word_freq_5+word_freq_6+word_freq_7+word_freq_8+word_freq_9+word_freq_10+word_freq_11+word_freq_12+word_freq_13+word_freq_14+word_freq_15+word_freq_16+word_freq_17+word_freq_18+word_freq_19+word_freq_20+word_freq_21+word_freq_22+word_freq_23+word_freq_24+word_freq_25+word_freq_26+word_freq_27+word_freq_28+word_freq_29+word_freq_30+word_freq_31+word_freq_32+word_freq_33+word_freq_34+word_freq_35+word_freq_36+word_freq_37+word_freq_38+word_freq_39+word_freq_40+word_freq_41+word_freq_42+word_freq_43+word_freq_44+word_freq_45+word_freq_46+word_freq_47+0.1), 0.0, 10.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "extreme_capital_flag",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Soft indicator combining heavy capitalization patterns via clipped log composite.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "capital_usage",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Bounded severity score that saturates for very long capital runs.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(np.log1p(capital_run_length_longest) / 8.0, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "promotional_tone_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic judgment score combining elevated symbol usage, sustained capital runs, and high frequency of high-base-rate marketing-like tokens into a single normalized promotional-intent score. Computed without reference to outcome labels, only row-level stylistic cues.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_style",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a compact semantic axis that linear SVM can weight directly for margin separation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
